page.overview:
Who is Shirma?

Shirma Magnolie is a kind-hearted White Mage who is a constant worrier in Final Fantasy Fables: Chocobo's Dungeon. She is a supporting character to Chocobo who lives with her Aunt Stella at the farm at the outskirts of Lostime. Shirma does not like that the townspeople are okay with losing their memories, because she personally had precious memories she wanted to keep.

Shirma is a recurring type of character in the Chocobo series, a pink-haired White Mage.

A book in the empty house after the ending reveals that she and her sister are the daughters of two of the nine former heroes who died against the Destroyer: Elena, the White Mage; and Nero, the Black Mage. In Shirma's early life, she got a painful injury and her sister healed her with white magic. Shirma wanted to learn too and her sister believed white magic was the perfect school of magic for her. As Shirma promised to practice a lot, her sister vowed that they'd always be together. Shirma held this promise dear in her heart from thereafter. Alexander eventually blessed Shirma as the Oracle of Light.

When The Destroyer attacked the town that would be later be known as Lostime, Mayor Gale urged the Oracles to release the power of the Guardian Beasts to seal the Destroyer, even though this would seal everyone's memories away. Shirma did not want to lose her memories, but when her weakened sister begged her to follow through, Shirma obeyed and summoned the Guardian Beast of Light, Alexander. Shirma and the other Oracles sealed the Destroyer away, sealing Memoria from the rest of the world. Shirma's parents were killed during the battle.
